title: Setting up a reaction
caption: A round-bottomed flask heated in a mantle with a reflux condenser on top lets a reaction be heated for a long time without losing solvent; a dropping funnel adds a reagent slowly to control an exothermic reaction.
alt: A round-bottomed flask on a heating mantle with a vertical condenser and a dropping funnel.
description: Flask with reaction mixture and anti-bumping granules.
Vertical condenser, water in at the bottom.
Dropping funnel to add reagent dropwise.
